keySentence: The giant chased Jack down fast.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The giant saw Jack. Jack ran away. The giant followed him. The giant chased Jack down fast.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The giant spotted Jack hiding under the table. Jack grabbed the gold coins and ran for the door. The giant chased Jack down fast through the castle. Jack reached the beanstalk and started climbing down. The giant followed him down the shaking beanstalk. Jack could feel the giant getting closer and closer.
facts.Word cards: climbed = 올랐다 / up = 위로 / cloud = 구름 / brave = 용감한
